summary: The task cut is a policy decision; current tool capabilities differ enough that routing must enforce the chosen cut.

items.text: Claude Code supplies scripted workflows plus ordinary subagents; workflow-sized cards require a qualified headless activation and allowlist.
Codex supplies native subagents and per-agent model configuration, but this pattern keeps non-interactive orchestration on small dependency-linked cards until the runner contract is verified.
LangGraph orchestrator-worker workflows: dynamic workers with separate state and a synthesis node provide a programmable substrate for one workflow-sized task.
Temporal child workflows: durable child execution, retry and cancellation policies can isolate long-running slices while preserving one parent workflow record.
